description_en: Modifies the sync task of a community-compatible ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster
description_zh: 调用ModifyRDSToClickhouseDb接口修改云数据库ClickHouse社区兼容版集群的同步任务
kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse modify-rds-to-clickhouse-db --db-cluster-id cc-bp158i5wvj4360000 --ck-user-name user1 --ck-password 123456Aa --rds-id rm-uf6x3qq4t90ok0000 --rds-user-name user2 --rds-password 123456Rr --skip-unsupported true --rds-syn-tables table --rds-syn-db database --api-version 2019-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyRDSToClickhouseDb

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The port number of the ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster
parameters.name: clickhouse_port

parameters.help_en: The database account of the ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster
parameters.help_zh: 云数据库ClickHouse的数据库账号
parameters.name: ck_user_name

parameters.help_en: The password of the ApsaraDB for ClickHouse database account
parameters.help_zh: 云数据库ClickHouse的数据库账号密码
parameters.name: ck_password

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance
parameters.name: rds_id

parameters.help_en: The port number of the ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance
parameters.help_zh: 云数据库RDS MySQL的端口号
parameters.name: rds_port

parameters.help_en: The VPC ID of the ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance
parameters.name: rds_vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The database account of the ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance
parameters.help_zh: 云数据库RDS MySQL的数据库账号
parameters.name: rds_user_name

parameters.help_en: The password of the ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL database account
parameters.help_zh: 云数据库RDS MySQL的数据库账号密码
parameters.name: rds_password

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to ignore databases that do not support synchronization. Valid values:

true: Ignore the databases.

false: Do not ignore the databases
parameters.help_zh:
是否忽略不支持同步的库，取值说明：

true：忽略。
false：不忽略
parameters.name: skip_unsupported

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of rows to sync per second
parameters.name: limit_upper

parameters.help_en: The tables in the ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance
parameters.name: rds_syn_tables

parameters.help_en: The database in the ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance
parameters.help_zh: 云数据库RDS MySQL的数据库
parameters.name: rds_syn_db

ErrorMsg.description_en:
This parameter is not returned if Status is 1.

If Status is 0, this parameter indicates the reason why the modification failed
ErrorMsg.description_zh:
当Status返回为1时，不返回该参数。
当Status返回为0时，表示修改失败的原因
ErrorMsg.example: ClickHouse exception, code: 49, host: 100.100.118.132, port: 49670; Code: 49, e.displayText() = DB::Exception: Logical error: there is no global context (version 20.8.17.25)n

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether the modification was successful. Valid values:

1: The modification was successful.

0: The modification failed
Status.description_zh:
修改是否成功，取值说明：

1：修改成功。
0：修改失败
